heads.en: In front of the Kawakawa Chongryon Congress, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has ordered the President of the United States, Donald Trump, to open an Asian visit to China on the eve of the summit. The announcement by the United States on 16 December to expand the export controls of the AIS chip to include Singapore, Malaysia and other five countries as high-risk countries has led to strong discontent in Beijing. The Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, by its spokesman, Guo Jiakun, has apprehensively approved the use of export controls by the American side, which are typical of "economic coercion" and "long arms rule" and has threatened to take the necessary measures to protect his rights and interests. A minute ago, Luk Chuan Province, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in front of the Kawakawa Tsumi Tsumi University, ordered "the economy to be under pressure, the long arm to control".
